### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only what was asked": quoting now on the unchanged ledger violates both "not fixed until" / "fixed only after" sentences; and it gives a different number (used share 10.61/20 = 0.53 -> no usage percentage -> 5 total -> 3002.00). Posting S alone leaves 13.43/20 = 0.6715 -> 3002.00, so T bears weight too.
- Standard block-price clause: excluded by block_ordering_and_price_terms "No longer in force for a repeat order"; would give 3160.00.
- Installation reading of SB-2306631: excluded, no delivered Hardware Procurement order.
- SB-2309118 as "the" onsite ticket: excluded by resolution stamp (10-13 10:30 < 10-14 20:30).
- 120-minute raise on the visit: excluded, tier 2 applies only to "Any other service visit" than an emergency call-out.
- Tenure 1 percent per year: excluded, that tier is for Professional/Premier/Enterprise; Standard is on the flat 2 percent tier.
- Travel at base 1.0 trip hours: excluded by the trip-value schedule for an active agreement with trip charge above zero.

### Openness noted (policy-side, not a document verdict)
- Trip value rounding: the trip-value schedule rounds "that trip charge divided by the block's rate per block hour, rounded half up to the hundredth of an hour" while the travel baseline rounds "once, on the final figure"; both readings give 1.55 here.
